```{r} 

sites <- get_wq_sites()

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  sf::st_bbox() %>%
  sf::st_as_sfc() %>%
  sf::st_buffer(1000)

land_barrier <- sf::st_difference(
  study_extent,
  sf::st_union(study_area)
) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf()

cost_raster <- ipdw::costrasterGen(
  xymat = sites,
  pols = land_barrier,
  extent = "polys",
  projstr = sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string,
  resolution = 100
)



dist_pwr <- c(
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  1.25,
  1.5,
  2,
  2.5,
  3
)

max_rng <- c(
  5000, 
  10000,  
  15000,
  20000
)

```

# Salinity

Test model sensitivity against distance power X max range interactions
```{r}
# SAL

sal_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  n_seeds = 5,
  value_col = "mean",
  unit = "ppt",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng
)

sal_sensitivity

# save distance power output for later reference
saveRDS(
  sal_sensitivity,
  file = here::here("2-data", "models", "salinity_sensitivity_test.rds")
)

```

 run model using tuned parameters

```{r}

set.seed(42) 

sal_folds <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = sal_clean,
  k = 5,
  size = 5000,  # spatial block size in metres for a projected CRS
  selection = "random",
  plot = TRUE
)

sal_ipdw <- ipdw_stats(
  df = sal_clean,
  cost_raster = cost_raster,
  folds = sal_folds,
  dist_pwr = 0.5,
  max_range = 15000,
  value_col = "mean"
)

plot(sal_ipdw)

sal_surface <- ipdw_manual(
  sf_ob = sal_clean,
  cost_ras = cost_raster,
  range = 15000,
  par_list = "mean",
  dist_power = 0.5
)

plot(sal_surface)

saveRDS(sal_ipdw, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_ipdw.rds"))
saveRDS(sal_surface, file = here::here("2-data", "models", "sal_surface.rds"))

```
